summary: Bitmine Immersion Technologies filed an 8-K to report entry into an underwriting agreement with Moelis & Company LLC and Cantor Fitzgerald & Co. for the issuance and sale of 3,500,000 shares of 9.50% Series A Perpetual Preferred Stock at $80.00 per share, expected to settle June 10, 2026. Net proceeds of ~$273.8M will fund general corporate purposes including digital asset acquisition, staking infrastructure, and common stock repurchases. This is a capital-raising shelf takedown, not a special situation. No deal terms beyond the offering are stated.
